Name: MallangSlangToys
Author: ehullim
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod adds craftable 'Mallang' and 'Slang' squishy toys to the game. You can unlock various recipes through NPC letters and sell your crafted toys for profit.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Install SMAPI[/b] (v4.0.0 or higher).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Install Content Patcher (CP)[/b] and [b]Mail Framework Mod (MFM)[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place both
[/color]
[code][CP] MallangSlangToys[/code][color=#D4D4D8]and
[/color]
[code][MFM] MallangSlangToys[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folders into your
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI.
[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]17 New Items Added:[/b] Crafts various 'Mallang' (Squishy) and 'Slang' (Slime) toys with custom sprites and descriptions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]New Base Recipe:[/b] Unlocks the [b]Mallang Base[/b] recipe to get started with toy crafting.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]NPC Mail Recipes:[/b] Build friendships with villagers (Jas, Marnie, Emily, Linus, Lewis, Wizard) to receive unique recipe letters in your mailbox![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Default Recipes Included:[/b] 10 basic toy recipes are unlocked from the start so you can craft right away.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Craft & Sell for Profit:[/b] Sell your crafted squishy toys through the shipping bin to earn gold![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Custom NPC Gift Tastes:[/b] Villagers have their own unique reactions to receiving Mallang and Slang toys as gifts.
[/color]


[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size][/*]
